transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling Nimbus Telecom. My name is Daniel. How can I help you today?
Customer: Hi Daniel, I'm really frustrated. My current data plan is way too small for what I need, and I've been paying for things I don't even use. I need to change my plan immediately.
Agent: I am sorry to hear that you've been feeling frustrated with your current plan. I can certainly help you switch to a better one today.
Customer: Thank you. I just want something with more data and a simpler price.
Agent: I can definitely do that. Before we look at the account details, could you please provide your account number and date of birth?
Customer: Sure, my account number is 95359381 and my date of birth is 21/12/1981.
Agent: Thank you, Mr. Khan. I see your account. To get you more data, I recommend the Unlimited Data Plan. It will be 45 dollars per month, and the change will take effect on the first of next month.
Customer: That sounds much better. I'm Karan Khan, by the way, and my phone number is 93132 71411. Is there any way to get a streaming add-on included?
Agent: I can add that for you. Don't worry, this add-on will be free forever for you.
Customer: That is amazing! I'm so glad we could get this sorted. Can you send the confirmation to karan.54@examplemail.com?
Agent: Of course. I will process the plan change now and send a confirmation SMS to your mobile.
Customer: Perfect, thank you so much for your help, Daniel. I'm very happy now.
Agent: You are very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today? I've updated your plan and the confirmation is on its way. Goodbye!
